reference_part.role: Context only. The OEM intercooler interfaces (flanges, inlet and outlet axes, mounts) are not measured in this repository and are not used.
reference_part.declared_core_source: catalog/reference/993-declared-part-data.json (aftermarket AKS DASIS 177020T core 260 x 270 x 60 mm, 7.06 kg)

basis.witness: ../results/thin-sizing.json best_screen_candidate (offset strip, two parallel charge banks)
basis.scenarios_and_budgets: Taken unchanged from ../requirements.json: 35 C ambient, 40 C compressor inlet, 60 C charge target, 2.5 kg/s imposed cooling flow, 10 kPa charge and 500 Pa ambient budgets, heat transfer x0.75 and friction x2 stress factors.

search_envelope.note: Same faces as the witness thin-fin sweep; depth extended to 150 mm, the hot-weather envelope depth.

helical.description: HelixHeatX transposed to air-air crossflow: charge in printed round tubes, each carrying a helical internal web (a printed twisted tape), cooling air across a staggered bare-tube bank.
helical.layout: equilateral staggered, longitudinal pitch = transverse pitch x sqrt(3)/2
helical.hot_correlation: Manglik and Bergles (1993) turbulent twisted-tape tube; admitted for Re >= 10000 and 2.5 <= y; tape treated as a non-conducting insert (no web fin area credited).
helical.hot_reynolds_convention: Worst case of the plain-tube and tape-reduced flow-area conventions: the lower heat transfer and the higher pressure drop are kept.
helical.cold_correlation: Zukauskas staggered tube bank (Re_max 1000-200000) with row correction; pressure drop by the Jakob staggered friction factor (Re_max 2000-40000) plus the study entry/exit K.
helical.transcription_status: Correlations transcribed from secondary textbook forms; verify against the original papers before any decision.

gyroid.description: Two-network sheet gyroid: charge on one side of the sheet, cooling air on the other.
gyroid.thermal_model: No admitted correlation. A plain-duct analogue (Nu 4.0, Darcy f.Re 64 on the network hydraulic diameter) is reported for orientation only, plus the break-even Nusselt number that would be required.
gyroid.header_status: Each gyroid network opens on every face of a box. Separating the two networks into crossflow headers needs transition zones that are not designed here.
